function VerifyLicense(long AccNum, stri.reason: Licence check at attach: posts the account id (B39+: plus the brokerFacts payload) to /api/ea/check, maps the HTTP reply to LICENSE_VALID or an error code and shows a prompt. No order, position, input or setting; it only decides whether the EA starts, like GOATEADeviceActivation.mqh on the file allowlist. Reached only from OnInit. The EBB28 version is not reviewed.

function BuildOptimizationBatchPromptSum.reason: Reads the queue file, item_stats.tsv and the batch log and formats the three end-of-batch prompt lines (runs, no-edge items, errors, timings, XML/export issue counts) into its string outputs. No order, position, input, file write or export decision. The call graph reaches it from OnTesterDeinit only through the prompt shown after a batch.

function CStrategyTesterDialog::ApplyStu.reason: Studio panel stage layout: hides, moves, recolours, relabels, enables and disables dialog controls for stages 01-04 and the read-only monitor, then redraws. Reads no input value and writes no setting, file or order. The call graph reaches it only from OnInit, OnTimer and OnChartEvent (panel), not from a trading entry point.
